title: Musical family, the uncle's violin, Cajun dances and school
summary: His mother's people all played music; his uncle played for Cajun dances, and he and his siblings formed string trios. Playing excused kids from school exams.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
